content:
There's now an exprimental slide genre for Verso.

Features:

  • Lean code is elaborated and highlighted by Verso, reducing the risk of incorrect examples on slides (whether due to human error or AI hallucination)
  • Almost all reveal.js features are exposed via Verso/Lean
  • Embedded Lean code can be clicked on for more information, showing proof states, type signatures, and docs in a dedicated panel. There are no hovers, because they tend to get in the way during talks, but all the information is accessible via clicks.

  • There is a client-side JS implementation of Lean's pretty printer, so resizing the info panel also reflows proof states.

  • It's extensible via Verso, so you can build reusable templates and building blocks.

This package is still in its infancy, but it has been used for real talks already.

Please direct questions to the thread
